release.metadataInspection: Official latest-release API response inspected read-only; the official release page independently identifies v2.9.8 and2026-10-21. Execution must revalidate the pinned tag and asset identities, never resolve latest again.

manualInstallationContract: The official documentation identifies the Windows x86_64 ZIP, one executable per platform archive and a matching.sha256sum file. Use an absolute executable path, without installer scripts, global package installation or PATH changes.
workspaceDirectoryIgnoredProbe: git check-ignore audit/2026-10-27/.final26-runtime/deno-v2.9.8/deno.exe returned the exact path
stepsAfterRootGo: Verify actual frozen source26 inventory505 and the fresh build explicitly bound by SPAROWTYPE_FINAL26_BUILD_ID; verify the ignored destination boundary.
Read official pinned-release API metadata and verify exact release ID, tag, non-prerelease state and both asset IDs/sizes/URLs/SHA256 digests.
Create a new ignored workspace runtime directory without replacing an existing installation.
Download the177-byte checksum sidecar once; verify its own published SHA256 and that its one archive digest matches the pinned archive digest.
Download the42,917,472-byte ZIP once; enforce bounded HTTPS/redirect hosts, byte count, timeout and pinned SHA256 before extraction.
Inspect the ZIP before extraction: require exactly one ordinary deno.exe entry and bounded uncompressed size; extract only that entry within the new workspace directory.
Hash the executable, run only the verified absolute binary with --version, require Deno2.9.8/stable/windows-x64 and record all hashes/provenance.

After setup succeeds and only in the separately coordinated CI window, set SPAROWTYPE_DENO_BINARY to the absolute recorded executable and DENO_DIR to the ignored cache directory, then run run-final26-ci-extra.mjs.
